issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML in problem_statement.md declares the method as public (+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int), but the reference solution implements it with protected visibility (protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()). This difference in access modifier can confuse students about the intended API (whether the method should be publicly callable) and may lead to inconsistent student implementations or incorrect expectations when using or testing the class.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the access modifier consistent between the specification and the reference solution. Preferably change the solution method signature to public (public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()) in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java so it matches the UML and the tasks description. Alternatively, if protected was intentional, update the problem_statement.md UML to show protected visibility and clarify the intended API in the task text.
